contract.original_requirement: Supply relevant prior rulings with explicit scope, evidence and revision applicability; retain findings when code changes.
contract.observed_missing_behavior: Decision records cannot represent declared file scope or the reviewed revision. Standalone discovery relies only on prose path mentions; review always reports applicability unestablished even when source evidence can distinguish changed files.
contract.behavior: Optional immutable scope with exact repository-relative paths, reviewed commit and complete conditions. Review discovers explicitly scoped decisions, reports submitted scope intersections and Git/worktree source comparisons, and requires reassessment of affected decisions without suppressing findings. Legacy records retain unknown applicability.
acceptance: Public record/recovery retains explicit scope and conditions; legacy event serialization/hashes remain unchanged.
VB/WebForms-shaped review discovers scoped decisions without prose path mentions and excludes unrelated explicit scopes even when prose mentions a changed file.
Review identifies changed scoped source, unchanged source and unavailable baseline separately, and never equates matching HEAD with applicability of a submitted patch.
JSON/Markdown retain decision evidence and current findings; existing bounded response/recovery and historical cutoff checks remain passing.
Validate candidate and installed public MCP behavior before marking deployed.
contract.review: Code-review skill retained; CodeRabbit host authentication unavailable; scoped manual review required.
limits: Declared authorship/conditions are evidence, not authenticated policy authority. No automatic exception suppression or semantic validation of conditions.
contract.resource_retention: Reuse existing batch-read-source checkout and shared target. Retain receipts here; remove owned fixture temp after handles close. No preexisting directory deletion.

remaining: Build release, verify candidate and installed public scoped-decision workflow, deploy, and record exact runtime identity. No deployed claim yet.

build_owner.cleanup_condition: Only after exact owned Job empty and relay/handles closed; retain on interruption
